verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show an extensive, well-documented API surface covering nearly every core capability also available in the Dashboard/UI (payments, refunds, disputes, billing, invoicing, webhooks, sandboxes, idempotency, MCP server/CLI for agents), suggesting broad API/UI parity for an AI-native builder. However, several features are explicitly framed as 'no-code'/Dashboard-first (e.g. no-code refunds on Payment Links, no-code revenue recovery, Dashboard-created hosted invoices) without an explicit claim that every one of these has a full programmatic equivalent, so total parity is implied rather than proven. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or audit confirming 1:1 feature parity between Dashboard and API (e.g., Radar rule configuration, Connect onboarding UI flows, analytics dashboards) and independent verification that no UI-only feature exists.
